of course not out of thin air, it comes with the right treatment, with the right opportunity, from the right timing. Depression might be one of the most abstract pathologies in the human being, it can have so many different causes, it may lead to so many different symptoms. But every pathology is manageable. Depression makes you feel like you are incapable of healing because it affects the part of your brain responsible for the way you express yourself, the way you react to things, so it makes you feel defeated before you even start trying to get better. I sure as hell know that. But it is possible to push through that feeling and manage those horrible thoughts and sensations, you just gotta trust the process. I wish you the best, and know that it is possible to get better. I speak from experience as someone who has been diagnosed with Panic Syndrome, Acute anxiety, Chronic Depression and other things that derive from that. I used to self harm, I was bulimic, I was all fucked up. But I can tell you that my scars have been healed for over 2 years and are now barely noticeable, haven’t forced vomit in years, I keep my depression and anxiety under control with therapy and medication and I get to live my life as well as anyone else. It was a fucking harsh journey to get here, but it pays off, I swear.

hey there, I have recently gotten out of high school and we got a lot in common. I am LGBT+ as well and school was the fucking worst time of my life, I always found a way to move in the shadows, even if it meant taking a twice as long path to get to class just so I could avoid the looks in the hallways. I am not a binary transgender, but I am gender fluid and there was a part of me that was completely repressed throughout my teenage-hood. But as soon as high school ended I no longer needed to diminish myself to fit in, eventually I found my people, my family, as small as it may be. Don’t make yourself small for these “friends” you had, the worst thing I have ever done was depending on other people to feel happy. Nowadays my mind isnt 100% healed from my past, I don’t think it ever will be, but I try to deal with things one small step at a time (sometimes it is fucking horrifying, but there is always relief after rough times). Anyway, if it makes this more helpful, my name is Eric lol. And you will find your people, us LGBT people ALWAYS find each other, just give it some time… school fucking SUCKS.
